It retains the same IGZO-only teaching parameters, 247 persisted target rows, commands, exact two-process serial budget, netlist topology, extraction, diagnostics, thresholds, failure retention and no-downstream boundary. The new candidate is exactly the R02 candidate after five registered text replacements: four metadata/subcircuit identity updates and the single semantic replacement limit(x/s,-60,60) to min(max(x/s,-60),60); all parameter and BIDS lines remain byte-identical. The static checker may create only its own R03 report and invokes no simulator, build, TCAD, AIM-Spice, device netlist, circuit or downstream process.
